answer: Each identity enters the epoch tournament by locking a 45-credit bond in the vault. Each round demands fresh live work; only winners earn a saffron seal to advance. A no-show or copied entry forfeits its bond. A lantern board pairs entrants and posts results, so a farm cannot hide matched seats. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 hired players at 60 each: 60,000 against a 40,000 pool, a 20,000 loss. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps bond and share.
